observations: Photo 0: A black LG TV displaying a dynamic action scene with water splashes and a vehicle. The LG logo is visible in the bottom right corner of the screen and on the bezel below the screen.
Photo 1: The same TV showing a different action scene with a motorcycle and city background. The LG logo is again visible in the bottom right of the screen and on the bezel.

Photo 2: The TV displaying a third scene with a motorcycle and a red fire hydrant. The screen shows a visible horizontal line or crack across the lower part of the display. The LG logo is present in the bottom right and on the bezel.
All photos show the TV mounted or placed against a light-colored wall. The screen content appears to be a video game or movie trailer, with a watermark 'BIG SOLOMONS ELECTRONICS' overlaid.
The TV has a thick black bezel and a stand base visible in the photos. No ports, model number, or back panel are shown.

claims.evidence: LG brand visible on bezel and screen in all photos; size is consistent with 32" based on proportions and bezel thickness; no smart interface or apps visible in screen content.

The screen displays vibrant images, but clarity cannot be assessed without comparing to known reference content or checking for pixelation, motion blur, or resolution. The watermark may also affect perceived clarity.

risks.risk: Visible screen damage (horizontal line/crack in photo 2)
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the lower screen area showing the line/crack, ideally with the screen turned off to confirm it's a physical crack or dead pixel line.
risks.if_unproven: priced as damaged, with reduced value due to potential repair cost or cosmetic defect

risks.proof: Photo of the TV's menu or input selection screen showing no internet or app options, or a photo of the back panel showing only analog or HDMI ports without smart features.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly smart, which would increase value; if unproven, priced as non-smart

risks.proof: Photo of the back panel or bottom bezel showing the model number, or a photo of the power-on screen showing model details.
risks.if_unproven: priced at worst-case for a generic 32" non-smart LG TV, without premium model benefits

risks.risk: Physical damage to bezel or stand
risks.proof: Photo of the entire TV from the side and back, showing the stand, bezel edges, and any dents or scratches.
risks.if_unproven: priced as possibly damaged, with reduced value

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the lower screen area showing the horizontal line/crack, with screen turned off.
Photo of the back panel or bottom bezel showing the model number.
Photo of the TV's menu or input selection screen to confirm non-smart status.
Photo of the entire TV from the side and back to check for physical damage.
response.reason: The TV is identifiable as an LG 32" non-smart model, but critical risks such as screen damage (visible line in photo 2) and unknown model/age prevent a confident price assessment. Proof is needed to verify the extent of damage, model, and functionality before pricing.
